# Data Source: auth0_organization_clients

Data source to retrieve all client (application) associations for a specific organization (EA only).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "auth0_organization_clients" "my_org_clients" {
  organization_id = "org_XXXXX"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization to retrieve the client associations for.

### Read-Only

- `clients` (List of Object) The list of clients (applications) associated with the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clients))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--clients"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clients`

Read-Only:

- `app_type` (String)
- `client_id` (String)
- `grant_types` (List of String)
- `is_first_party` (Boolean)
- `logo_uri` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `use_for_member_access` (Boolean)
